question: Tell me about something you worked on with other people recently. What happened?
transcript: When I was in uni, I had to do a group project. We had to build a Django application for a client called Sky. We had a twelve week deadline, and we also supposed to give weekly reports to the engineers. So I designed the database schema and the front end, and the team was depending on my output to move forward. So I mapped down all of the entities and the relationships. I made the conceptual ERD first and then made it into a logical ERD before we touched code so everyone had a clear picture before building on it. Then I moved to the front end design with the teammate. So we designed wireframes, layout, and how everything connected. We were able to deliver on time. We passed all the checks, and we also gave weekly reports to the lecturers and the sky engineers.

question: Tell me about something you worked on with other people recently. What happened?
